rollout.missing_schema: 503 AUTH_SESSION_POLICY_NOT_READY for login completion, refresh and authenticated session checks
rollout.migration_effect: Add nullable refresh_tokens.replaced_by_auth_session_id only; no backfill, seed, session revocation or business writes
rollout.schema_rollback: Refuse down() while any persisted replacement marker exists; retain schema for application rollback
rollout.activation_effect: Legacy JWTs without sid must log in again. Existing sid families remain usable until normal expiry/revocation or a completed replacement login; activation does not choose an old-family winner.

identity.family: refresh_tokens.auth_session_id, fallback to row id for historical rows
identity.new_login: New family; revoke active account families and persistently supersede all previous account credentials, including rotated and logged-out ancestors. Preserve existing replacement markers.
identity.access_only: When enabled, persist a family and issue sid even if refresh transport is unavailable. Do not deliver any refresh token without the approved transport.
identity.refresh_and_switch_context: Keep original family; never replace another family

atomicity.lock_order: Parent user row, then token rows; same order as refresh/password/logout
atomicity.commit_boundary: Final-factor authentication accepted, new session persisted and access token generated in one database transaction
atomicity.mfa_challenge_only: No replacement; replace only after successful second factor
atomicity.token_generation_failure: Roll back session insertion, replacement markers and previous refresh revocation
atomicity.lost_response: Commit may have succeeded. HTTP delivery is not atomic with database commit; no transparent retry or restoration of the old family.
atomicity.parallel_logins: Serialized completion; last committed login is the only active family
atomicity.login_refresh_race: A pre-login rotation may finish but its family is replaced by the subsequent login. A post-replacement refresh is rejected without revoking the successor. Late access responses cannot revive a replaced family.
atomicity.request_admission: Global credential middleware checks persisted family state on protected requests without a revocation cache. Requests admitted before replacement are not cancelled or automatically rolled back.

responses.401_AUTH_SESSION_REPLACED: Terminal access/refresh refusal from persisted replacement metadata; do not refresh, retry or transfer owner writes
responses.401_AUTH_SESSION_REQUIRED: Policy enabled, JWT has no stable sid; require explicit login
responses.401_AUTH_SESSION_EXPIRED: Existing family expiry/revocation contract; not proof of replacement
responses.401_UNAUTHENTICATED: Expired/invalid access JWT or generic invalid refresh credential; at most existing single-flight refresh rules, never hide a replacement error
responses.503_AUTH_SESSION_POLICY_NOT_READY: Configuration/schema not ready; do not clear local journals or synthesize logout success
responses.network_or_other_503: Not proof that session was replaced

discovery: data.account_session_policy on auth user/profile payload; version auth-session-replacement-v1

idle_client.required_client_check: GET /api/v1/auth/me when returning to foreground and before resuming commands
idle_client.guarantee: Replacement is detected on the next authenticated request reaching the server, not instant disconnection of an idle/offline device
idle_client.client_generation: Discard late responses from superseded local auth generations. Stop new writes on terminal auth errors; retain unresolved owner identities without replaying them under a new login.

retained_boundaries: No work-shift END or ownership transfer
No draft/journal deletion, cancellation, recovery or UNKNOWN resolution
No source-linked receipt or business POST changes
No browser FE domain added to body-token allowlist
Public login/refresh/MFA/health routes still ignore stale bearer credentials as before
Existing non-replacement refresh replay security remains in effect
Turning the rollout flag off does not clear persisted replacement markers or revive those families
No live two-device or idle-client acceptance inferred from source tests
